# package iec101

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101"
```

Package iec101 holds what the controlling and the controlled station of IEC 60870-5-101 share: the system parameters, the link [State](#type-state) and the sentinel errors.

IEC 60870-5-101 carries the telecontrol ASDUs of package asdu in FT 1.2 frames (package ft12) over a serial line, with the link procedures of IEC 60870-5-2 (package link):

  - unbalanced transmission: the controlling station is the primary station and polls the controlled station for class 1 data (events, confirmations) and class 2 data (cyclic data); see ModeUnbalanced
  - balanced transmission: each station initiates its own messages over a full-duplex point-to-point line; see ModeBalanced

Applications import [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/client](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/client) and [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/server](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/server). The transport is any io.ReadWriter: a serial port (for example github.com/otfabric/go-serial), a TCP connection to a terminal server that carries the serial byte stream unchanged, or an in-memory pipe for tests. IEC 60870-5-101 over such a TCP stream is still IEC 60870-5-101 (FT 1.2 framing and link procedures), not IEC 60870-5-104.

## Variables

```go
var (
	// ErrClosed reports an operation on a closed client or server.
	ErrClosed = errors.New("iec101: closed")
	// ErrLinkDown reports an operation while the link is not initialized
	// (not yet, or no longer after the peer stopped answering).
	ErrLinkDown = errors.New("iec101: link not initialized")
	// ErrInvalidConfig reports a configuration a client or server cannot
	// be built with.
	ErrInvalidConfig = errors.New("iec101: invalid configuration")
	// ErrInHandler reports a client request called on one of the client's
	// own goroutines, from its Handler or OnState, where the answer it
	// waits for cannot arrive: those goroutines deliver it. The request is
	// not sent.
	ErrInHandler = errors.New("iec101: request from inside a handler")
)
```

Sentinel errors shared by the client and the server; test with errors.Is.

```go
var ErrProfile = errors.New("iec101: not allowed by the IEC 60870-5-101 profile")
```

ErrProfile reports an ASDU that the IEC 60870-5-101 profile does not allow; the error is a [\*ProfileError](#type-profileerror). Test with errors.Is.

## Functions

### func Defined101

```go
func Defined101(t asdu.TypeID) bool
```

Defined101 reports whether IEC 60870-5-101:2003 7.2.1.1 defines type t: 1 to 21, 30 to 40, 45 to 51, 70, 100 to 106, 110 to 113 and 120 to 126, or whether t is in the private range 136 to 255. The other values are reserved; among them are types the codec knows from IEC 60870-5-104 (58 to 64, 107, 127) and IEC TS 60870-5-7 (the security types, which this IEC 101 implementation does not carry).

### func Validate

```go
func Validate(a *asdu.ASDU, p asdu.Params) error
```

Validate checks an ASDU against the rules of the IEC 60870-5-101 profile that the codec, which IEC 60870-5-104 shares, does not enforce:

  - the type is defined by IEC 60870-5-101 ([Defined101](#func-defined101));
  - the cause of transmission is not 0 (7.2.3, table 14);
  - the common address is not 0, and the global address is used only by C\_IC\_NA\_1, C\_CI\_NA\_1, C\_CS\_NA\_1 and C\_RP\_NA\_1 (7.2.4);
  - end of initialization and the system commands except read (M\_EI\_NA\_1, C\_IC\_NA\_1, C\_CI\_NA\_1, C\_CS\_NA\_1, C\_TS\_NA\_1, C\_RP\_NA\_1, C\_CD\_NA\_1) carry one object, SQ = 0, with information object address 0 (7.3.3, 7.3.4);
  - information with a time tag is not sent as the answer to an interrogation, causes 20 to 36 (7.3.1: the causes listed for the time-tagged types).

The client and server apply it when [Params](#type-params).Strict is set.

## Types

### type Mode

```go
type Mode uint8
```

Mode is the link transmission mode.

```go
const (
	// ModeUnbalanced: the controlling station polls (IEC 60870-5-2 clause 5).
	ModeUnbalanced Mode = iota
	// ModeBalanced: both stations initiate messages (IEC 60870-5-2
	// clause 6). Requires a full-duplex point-to-point line.
	ModeBalanced
)
```

Transmission modes.

#### func (Mode) String

```go
func (m Mode) String() string
```

String returns "unbalanced" or "balanced".

### type Params

```go
type Params struct {
	// Mode is unbalanced or balanced transmission.
	Mode Mode
	// Link holds the link address size and the link timing.
	Link link.Config
	// ASDU holds the ASDU field sizes. A zero MaxSize is set to the largest
	// ASDU one frame carries.
	ASDU asdu.Params
	// Strict applies [Validate], the IEC 60870-5-101 profile checks, to
	// every ASDU sent and received. A refused ASDU is not sent (the call
	// fails with [ErrProfile]); a received one is dropped and logged by the
	// client, and by the server mirrored negatively with the "unknown ..."
	// cause of [ProfileError] (IEC 60870-5-101:2003 7.2.3) or dropped when
	// none fits. Off by default: the codec alone accepts what
	// IEC 60870-5-104 allows.
	Strict bool
}
```

Params are the IEC 60870-5-101 system parameters both stations must agree on.

#### func DefaultParams

```go
func DefaultParams() Params
```

DefaultParams returns a common profile: unbalanced, 1-octet link address, 1-octet cause of transmission, 1-octet common address and 2-octet information object address (IEC 60870-5-101 8, the interoperability list leaves each choice to the system).

#### func (Params) Normalize

```go
func (p Params) Normalize() (Params, error)
```

Normalize validates p and fills in defaults.

### type ProfileError

```go
type ProfileError struct {
	// Cause is the cause of transmission with which a controlled station
	// mirrors a refused control-direction ASDU (IEC 60870-5-101:2003
	// 7.2.3): unknown type identification, cause of transmission, common
	// address or information object address. Zero when no "unknown ..."
	// cause fits; the ASDU is then dropped.
	Cause asdu.Cause
	// Reason describes the violation.
	Reason string
}
```

ProfileError is why [Validate](#func-validate) refused an ASDU.


### type State

```go
type State uint8
```

State is the state of the link as seen by one station.

```go
const (
	// StateDown: the link is not initialized.
	StateDown State = iota
	// StateUp: the link is initialized and user data flows.
	StateUp
	// StateClosed: the station was closed.
	StateClosed
)
```

Link states.
